narratives.Overview: TypeScript SDK (@openclaw/voice-sdk) providing a provider-agnostic, media-rich, agent-first voice/video/screen/data call abstraction. Inspired by Moho (Voxeo). Supports WhatsApp, Twilio, Discord, SIP, and WebRTC providers via a shared VoiceProvider interface. Single WASocket constraint respected via shared connection manager.
narratives.TechStack: Library + CLI using TypeScript 6, Node.js 22+ — pnpm, tsdown, vitest, oxlint
narratives.Quality: Run task check before every commit. Achieve >= 85% coverage overall + per-module. Store secrets in secrets/ dir.
narratives.Branching: Allow direct commits to master: true
